create_imagenet1k_dataset: create an ImageNet1K dataset instance with a root path, train split, and optional transform
load_imagenet1k_sample: load a sample image and its class label from an ImageNet1K dataset by index
create_image_multi_caption_dataset: create an ImageMultiCaptionDataset from a JSON annotation file with images and multiple captions per image
load_coco_captions_dataset: create a COCO captions dataset with a root path, split, and optional image transform
load_flickr30k_captions_dataset: create a Flickr30K captions dataset with a root path, split, and optional image transform
